surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the self-limiting adsorption reactions of the ALD process, which ensure precise control of film thickness, conformality, and uniformity. The ALD process uses (methylcyclopentadienyl)trimethylplatinum (MeCpPtMe3) and air as precursors, with a cycle consisting of exposure to MeCpPtMe3, nitrogen purge, exposure to dry air, and another nitrogen purge. The surface reactions are not explicitly detailed in chemical equations but are described as self-limiting adsorption processes.
